commonLandings.feedback: That is one hop past the landing — count the nine hops again.
That is one hop short. Nine hops on from 9 lands on 18.

widget.missFeedback: Start at 9 and make 9 hops right, one number at a time.
widget.successFeedback: Nine hops on from 9 lands on 18 — double 9.

predict.reveal: 9 + 9 IS a double, so it is recalled directly rather than built: 9 + 9 = 18. Building it from 10 + 10 means adding 20 and then taking 2 back off, and counting from one walks through all eighteen counts — both slower than one recalled fact.
